adaptiveboss.config.adaptation.title: Adaptation
adaptiveboss.config.adaptation.adaptatio: Ticks between each adaptation evaluation (~20 ticks = 1 second). Range: 20–200.
adaptiveboss.config.adaptation.decayFact: Exponential decay applied to combat weights each cycle. Lower = more responsive but volatile. Range: 0.5–1.0.
adaptiveboss.config.adaptation.meleeThre: Melee damage ratio at which the boss switches to KITER archetype. Default: 0.60.
adaptiveboss.config.adaptation.rangedThr: Ranged damage ratio at which the boss switches to AGGRESSOR archetype. Default: 0.60.
adaptiveboss.config.adaptation.archetype: Consecutive cycles an archetype must be recommended before it is committed. Prevents flip-flopping. Default: 2.
adaptiveboss.config.tracking.title: Tracking
adaptiveboss.config.tracking.sessionExpi: Ticks of inactivity before a player's combat session expires. Expired sessions are ignored. Default: 200.
adaptiveboss.config.tracking.weightHitsB: When enabled, hits are weighted by actual damage dealt. A full-power shot counts more than a chip. Default: true.
adaptiveboss.config.tracking.filterNonRe: When enabled, spectators and fake players (bots) are excluded from combat tracking. Default: true.
adaptiveboss.config.debug.title: Debug
adaptiveboss.config.debug.debugLogging.t: Enables verbose archetype transition logging. Shows melee/ranged/magic ratios each adaptation cycle. Default: false.
